title: Staff Record
description: One worker row from comp/staff/grid (4207 entries). Row key is the getDetail id (hidden first column).

staff_id.description: Hidden first grid column; argument of getDetail(this,'<id>')

full_name.description: Often prefixed with badge no., e.g. '( JYB- 2678 ) SARKER TAPAN', '(LTA) KEVIN GUILLEM'

badge_no.description: Badge/company prefix extracted from full_name if present, else null

id_type.description: Observed: WP (Work Permit), IC (Singapore IC). Others likely exist.

created_on.description: Site format 'dd MMM yyyy', e.g. '05 Jan 2026'
